description: Colligative properties calculator — Freezing-point depression, boiling-point elevation, osmotic pressure and vapor-pressure lowering for a solution. Give solute= (name like sucrose, glucose, urea, NaCl, CaCl2, MgSO4, ethylene glycol, or any formula like C6H12O6) with solute_g= and solvent_g=, or molality= directly. van't Hoff factor is set from ideal ion counts for known salts (override with i=). solvent= water (default), benzene, cyclohexane, camphor, acetic acid, chloroform, ethanol, carbon tetrachloride, naphthalene, nitrobenzene, phenol. temp_c= (default 25) for osmotic pressure; water vapor pressure from the Antoine equation. mode=molar-mass with delta_t=, solute_g=, solvent_g= (kind=freezing|boiling) finds an unknown solute's molar mass. Ideal dilute-solution formulas, textbook constants. Offline, instant. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
